name: plugin-live
description: Live plugin AND config-row control for the RUNNING workstation service: declares plugin rows in the HMR-watched HOME patch layer, and applies CLI --patch overlay (config file) rows live through the profile-context overlay list - no container recreate, no service restart, no release path. Tools: 'plugin_list', 'plugin_add', 'plugin_remove', 'plugin_config_list', 'plugin_config_sync'

config.description: All fields have production-safe defaults; the plugin drives the harness' own patch/loader machinery.

patchFile.description: Absolute path of the live patch layer the tools write (default: $DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml, the HOME patch the harness watches).

configFile.description: Absolute path of the managed CLI --patch overlay (the workstation roster). Default: the first --patch file on the command line.

backupDir.description: Directory the overlay file is backed up into before every placement (default: /opt/omni/data/backups/config).

waitMs.description: Default wait budget of 'plugin_add'/'plugin_remove' until the Loader reflects the change (default 15000, capped at 60000).
